pick.name: LiveKit Agents
pick.what: Realtime voice/video agent framework (Python + TS/Node SDKs) with WebRTC infra
pick.why: TS agents (@livekit/agents) fit the monorepo; Apache-2.0; cloud free tier; self-hostable
pick.free_limits: Build (free): 1,000 agent session minutes/mo, 5 concurrent sessions, $2.50 inference credits; Ship from $50/mo; no BAA listed on free plan

best_free.name: Pipecat
best_free.what: Python voice/multimodal pipeline framework, many STT/TTS/LLM plugins, JS/RN/Swift/Kotlin client SDKs
best_free.why: Most provider-neutral; Piper/Kokoro/Groq/Ollama plugins enable near-$0 stacks

alts.name: Gemini Live API
alts.why: Lowest build effort for a prototype
alts.free_limits: Free tier/session limits not stated on page

alts.name: OpenAI Agents SDK (JS) realtime voice
alts.what: TS framework for multi-agent workflows and realtime voice agents over WebRTC
alts.free_limits: Library free; OpenAI API usage billed
alts.maintained: release date not shown on repo page (opened 2026-10-28)

decision: LiveKit Agents gives a TS-capable stack with free minutes, but healthcare voice needs a plan with a BAA or self-hosting. Choose Pipecat for a fully local STT/LLM/TTS Python pipeline.

verify.note: Build: 1,000 agent minutes, 5 concurrent, $2.50 inference credits; Ship from $50; HIPAA only from Scale. Note livekit.io now redirects to livekit.com: update url.
